profile.scraping_strategy_recommended: drupal_html_first_with_wp_json_fallback: most member sites are on the CAO-managed Drupal 10 House Member Website Platform (HMWP). Default press listing path is /media/press-releases/. A small minority (~5-10%) run WordPress (Divi-themed Crane, Schweikert, Hamadeh confirmed; possibly more in the WAF-blocked 93%). wp-json/wp/v2/posts is exposed on at least 3 of 28 non-blocked sample sites (Crane, Hamadeh, Schweikert) — opportunistic JSON path, not primary.
profile.requires_js_estimate: Low (<10%). Drupal HMWP renders the press listing server-side. WordPress members render server-side too. JS-only listings are rare but possible on heavily-Divi themed sites; needs Playwright spot-check during implementation.

cms_distribution_observed.note: 93% of homepages 403 from non-browser scraper IPs (Akamai WAF Reference #18.953d117). True CMS share for blocked majority cannot be measured without browser-class fetch (Playwright) or distributed source IPs.

press_path_distribution_observed.note: Among 14 non-200s, 7 were 403 (WAF), 7 were 404 (real path miss). Pattern suggests >70% of unblocked members use /media/press-releases.

profile.rss_pattern: House CAO Drupal sites historically expose /rss.xml or /feed/, but prior comprehensive probe shows all 6 candidate RSS endpoints returned 403 from scraper IPs (WAF). RSS discovery should be done via browser/Playwright on first-pass member onboarding.

wp_json_availability.confirmed_404_in_sample: majority of Drupal members (wp-json route absent)
wp_json_availability.estimated_share: <10% of members; opportunistic optimization, not the primary strategy

profile.estimated_first_wave_share: 70-80% of members reachable via Drupal HTML scraper hitting /media/press-releases. Add ~5-10% WordPress members reachable via wp-json or HTML. Remaining ~10-20% need per-member triage (Playwright, alt paths, RSS fallback). Akamai WAF is the dominant operational risk — daily collection will need browser-class fetch (Playwright with real Chrome UA) or rotating residential proxy.
known_oddities: Akamai WAF blocks scraper IPs after a small burst (observed 200s for first ~28 hosts, then full 403 for everything from same IP). Confirmed via WAF Reference #18.953d117 in 403 bodies.

DNS resolution failures (None status) on 4 subdomains in fresh probe (schiff, smith, granger, plus retry-time variability) — could be CDN edge issue or DNS timeout, not necessarily a non-existent host.
House CAO Drupal HMWP strips meta generator tag on some installs — those show as cms_family='custom' in homepage probe but are actually Drupal. Generator-only detection undercounts Drupal share.

Four member URLs in the prior recon seed had Unicode accents incorrectly stripped, producing dead subdomains (snchez, barragn, velzquez, hernndez). Manual overrides applied: lindasanchez, barragan, velazquez, hernandez (HTTP 200 verified 2026-04-24 in prior recon).
Kevin Kiley (CA-3) is recorded by the Clerk as party=I but caucus=R. Clerk-canonical party retained.
Non-voting delegates (DC, AS, GU, MP, VI) and resident commissioner (PR) included; same domain pattern (norton.house.gov, plaskett.house.gov, hernandez.house.gov, etc).
Pagination convention varies. Drupal HMWP listings typically use ?page=N (zero-indexed). WordPress members typically use /page/N/ (one-indexed). No load-more JS required on observed samples.
Date format on listings is the AP-style 'Month D, YYYY' across both CMSes; same parsing logic as Senate.
next_actions_for_implementation: Build Drupal HMWP collector that hits {official_url}/media/press-releases/ with httpx + browser UA + retry/backoff for Akamai 403.
Spot-check ~50 members with Playwright to confirm CMS detection on the WAF-blocked 93%.
For ~5-10% confirmed-WP members, add wp-json/wp/v2/posts collector (mirrors Senate WP pattern; may also expose op_eds/newsletters custom post types — check /wp-json/wp/v2/types per member).
Akamai mitigation: residential proxy or Playwright/headed Chrome. Daily run from GitHub Actions IPs is likely to be soft-blocked at scale; needs operational test with full roster.
Set up per-member health check identical to Senate: HTTP 200, list_item count > 0, date_parse success rate > 95%.
Anticipate ~3-5% needing custom selectors per House oddities (legacy ColdFusion, vanity Divi/WordPress, or all-JS sites).
